# Scope Card

> Draw the line before the work starts. A browser tool for independent designers, developers, and consultants on fixed-price work.

Scope Card is a one-page in/out card you attach to a proposal. What's included. What's not. How extras get priced. Nothing is uploaded. It stays in the browser.

That's Extra is for after the extra ask. Scope Card is for before they sign.

## Pages
- [Home / generator](https://latinsushi.github.io/scope-card/)
- [In scope / out of scope](https://latinsushi.github.io/scope-card/in-scope-out-of-scope.html)
- [Statement of work one-pager](https://latinsushi.github.io/scope-card/statement-of-work-one-pager.html)

## Pricing
$19 once. Checkout is not wired yet. The generator is free to try. A license removes the free-version PDF line.
